definitions.gloss: departure from a country; leaving a country
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving one's country or the country one is currently in, especially passing through official border or immigration controls at an airport or port.

examples.japanese: {出国|しゅっこく}{手続|てつづ}きを{済|す}ませた。
{出国|しゅっこく}の{際|さい}にはパスポートの{提示|ていじ}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: You need to present your passport when leaving the country.

examples.japanese: {出国|しゅっこく}{審査|しんさ}に{長|なが}い{列|れつ}ができていたので、{搭乗|とうじょう}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}うか{心配|しんぱい}だった。
examples.english: There was a long line at the departure immigration, so I worried whether I would make it to boarding.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{出|しゅつ} (go out, exit) + {国|こく} (country). The reading changes to しゅっ before こく due to consonant assimilation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
{出国|しゅっこく}する is used as a する verb meaning "to leave a country."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出国|しゅっこく}する (to leave the country)
- {出国|しゅっこく}{審査|しんさ} (departure immigration check)
- {出国|しゅっこく}{手続|てつづ}き (departure procedures)
- {出国|しゅっこく}ゲート (departure gate)
- {出国|しゅっこく}{禁止|きんし} (travel ban, exit ban)
